content.query:
SELECT
    BalanceAmount AS AverageDailBalanceAmountMTDFull_Original,
    CustomerAccountPeriodBalance.BalanceAmount / COUNT(DCA.CustomerID) AS AverageDailBalanceAmountMTDProrated_Original,
    IsoCurrencyCode AS Currency_Original,
    'PHP' AS Currency_Target,
    CCFGD.ConversionRate AS PesoConversionRate
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance
INNER JOIN (SELECT AccountID, ShareIndicator, CustomerID FROM DW.DimCustomerAccount) DCA ON CustomerAccountPeriodBalance.CustomerAccountId = DCA.AccountID
INNER JOIN BNKM.CurrencyConversion_FillGapDates CCFGD ON CustomerAccountPeriodBalance.IsoCurrencyCode = CCFGD.ConvertFromCurrencyId AND CustomerAccountPeriodBalance.FinancialInstitutionId = CCFGD.FinancialInstitutionId AND CustomerAccountPeriodBalance.PeriodStartDate = CCFGD.CurrencyConversionTimestamp
WHERE DCA.ShareIndicator = 'Y'
AND CCFGD.ConvertToCurrencyId = 'PHP'
AND CCFGD.RateId = 'REV'
GROUP BY BalanceAmount, CustomerAccountPeriodBalance.BalanceAmount, IsoCurrencyCode, CCFGD.ConversionRate
